exposure: Pyramidal fixed-size patch generation with average pooling-based image decomposition
Handcrafted feature extraction based on local phase quantization (LPQ)
Chi-square iterative neighborhood component analysis feature selection (CINCA)
cohort: The study utilized a dataset of 671 expert-labeled fetal ultrasound images (339 male, 332 female) from individual subjects, where fetal sex was confirmed postnatally.
finding: The PFP-LHCINCA model achieved high accuracy (>=88% with all five tested classifiers and >98% with kNN and SVM classifiers) in automated fetal sex classification from ultrasound images.
